answer: A sparrow cannot fake a season of flights: give each agent a reputation that only grows through publicly auditable, useful work completed over time, with trust limits that rise slowly and decay when idle. A new identity starts near zero, so a pearl of high privilege is never granted on signup. Reaching the zenith tier requires months of verified deliveries, and misbehavior burns that history. An attacker must then pay real time and compute for every fake identity, while honest agents keep the reputation they already earned.
